title: Hyderabad Names Road 'Donald Trump Avenue' in First Such Honour for a US President in India
excerpt: Telangana's Congress government renamed a road near the US Consulate and tech offices of Microsoft, Google, and Amazon as part of a broader initiative to position Hyderabad as a global innovation hub — drawing both praise from Trump and sharp political backlash at home.
body:
Hyderabad, the Indian city that serves as a second home to many of America's biggest technology companies, has added a new landmark to its rapidly expanding landscape — one that carries the name of a sitting US president.

The Congress-led Telangana government this week formally renamed a road adjoining the United States Consulate in Hyderabad's Gachibowli Financial District as "Donald Trump Avenue," marking the first time an American president has been honoured with a street naming in India. US President Donald Trump acknowledged the gesture on Truth Social, writing: "The new Donald Trump Avenue in Hyderabad, India — The first U.S. President to ever be honoured in this way. Thank you!"

## The Freedom 250 Ceremony

The ceremonial plaque was unveiled on Tuesday during the "Freedom 250" event, a gala reception marking the 250th anniversary of American Independence. US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor and Telangana Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka jointly presided over the event, which drew senior diplomats, government officials, and leaders from the business, aerospace, defence and technology sectors.

Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy, who first proposed the road naming at the annual US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF) conclave in Delhi last year, attended the celebrations alongside US Consul General in Hyderabad Laura Williams.

Speaking at the event, Ambassador Gor praised Hyderabad's growing importance in bilateral relations. "Nowhere is the high-speed trajectory of our partnership more evident than in Hyderabad," he said. "From HITEC City to aerospace and defence, this region represents progress that is defining our bilateral momentum."

Gor also referenced ongoing economic cooperation: "With our interim trade agreement and Mission India on track to bring over $20 billion of new investment to the United States, we are proving that America First does not mean America alone."

## A Broader Renaming Initiative

The Trump Avenue designation is part of a broader initiative by the Telangana government to name key roads after globally recognised personalities and organisations. Several other renamings are planned: a prominent stretch will become "Google Street," recognising the search giant's upcoming campus in the Financial District — set to be Google's largest outside the United States. A greenfield radial road at the proposed Regional Ring Road will be named after the late industrialist Ratan Tata. Additionally, Wipro Junction and Microsoft Road are being planned, in line with the chief minister's vision of positioning Hyderabad as a global innovation hub.

## Political Backlash

The move has ignited sharp political debate across India. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) labelled the decision "hypocrisy," arguing that the Congress party has repeatedly criticised Trump's tariff policies and trade stance toward India while simultaneously honouring him. The Communist Party of India (Marxist) organised protests, describing the road naming as "glorification of a war monger" — a reference to the ongoing Iran-US tensions and broader American foreign policy.

Critics have also questioned Trump's claim of being "the first US President to ever be honoured in this way," noting that other American presidents, including Franklin D. Roosevelt and John F. Kennedy, have had streets named after them in several countries.

The ruling Congress party in Telangana, however, has framed the initiative as a strategic move to strengthen bilateral ties and attract foreign investment, not as a political endorsement. Officials said the special designation reflects Hyderabad's expanding role in US-India engagement across technology, innovation, investment, and strategic cooperation.

## What It Means for the Diaspora

The road naming carries particular significance for the Indian diaspora, especially the large community of NRIs with roots in Hyderabad and Telangana. The Financial District, where "Donald Trump Avenue" now stands, hosts the India operations of Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and dozens of other American technology companies. Thousands of Indian-American professionals shuttle between Silicon Valley and Hyderabad, and the city's tech corridor directly contributes to the estimated $140 billion in annual remittances flowing from the US to India.

The naming comes at a sensitive time in US-India trade relations, with both countries in the final stretch of negotiating an interim bilateral trade agreement. A high-level US delegation led by Chief Negotiator Brendan Lynch recently visited New Delhi to advance the talks, while Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Trump met at the G7 summit in France earlier this month. For NRIs navigating both economies, the symbolic gesture in Hyderabad may signal that despite political friction over tariffs and immigration, the economic partnership between the two nations continues to deepen.
